title: Complete Fletching Table(完全的制箭台)
description:
Here's the English translation of your sentence:
"This mod adds only one feature, to solve the problem of the vanilla fletching table having been useless for all these years."
body:
This mod adds only one feature to address the long-standing issue of the fletching table being useless in vanilla Minecraft. Players can use flint, sticks, and feathers at the fletching table to craft 8 arrows — double the yield of the vanilla recipe. Additionally, by combining glowstone dust or potions, players can craft spectral arrows and tipped arrows. The crafting process is more material-efficient than the vanilla method.

此模组只添加一个功能，为了解决原版制箭台这么多年都没有用处的尴尬。 玩家可以用燧石，木棍和羽毛可以在制箭台合成八支箭，比原版合成多了一倍。 并且搭配萤石粉和药水，可以合成光灵箭和药水箭。 制作比原版更省材料

v1.1 Changelog: Added compatibility with the JEI mod, allowing players to view recipes directly.

v1.1 更新日志：增加了对jei模组的适配，玩家可以直接查看配方了

v1.1.1 optimizes GUI display issues and fixes some minor bugs.

v1.1.1优化的GUI显示问题和一些小bug

v1.1.2 fixed the issue where holding food or potion-type items would cause automatic usage when opening the fletching table UI.

v1.1.2 解决了手持食物和药水类的物品时，打开制箭台的UI自动使用的问题

v1.1.3 Added a fix for the issue where UI icons were not displaying.

v1.1.3 添加了对UI界面图标不显示的问题
